title: Add a third-party extension interface to a local tool
decision: Choose whether the next alpha should expose a third-party extension interface with persistent local permissions.
options: Expose the extension interface in the next alpha
Ship one internal adapter and defer the public interface
Do nothing until a second real adapter exists

evidence.content: Two prospective users requested different integrations, but neither has committed to build or maintain one.
Extensions would receive persistent local permissions that the current single-adapter design does not expose.
The maintainer can support one internal adapter this cycle and has no compatibility budget for a public API.
